rationale: The ground-truth's substantive concern is Gaohan123's question about whether source_outputs[0] is reliably the parent output and whether a check/comment is warranted. Candidate X explicitly investigates and resolves exactly this (citing orchestrator.py's [output, *companion_outputs] construction), mirroring the actual author response, and also verifies CFG-companion handling and cross-checks against the sibling GLM-Image bridge with concrete code citations. Candidate Y never touches this concern at all, instead raising two speculative, lower-value findings (an unguarded empty-outputs IndexError and a logging traceability nit) that, while grounded in the diff and presented with clean actionable diffs, don't overlap with what reviewers actually flagged. Y's suggestions are more mechanically actionable (line-anchored diff snippets), but X's recall on the actual reviewer concern and depth of grounded verification make it the stronger review overall.
